import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.next();

        int atIndex = s.indexOf("at", 1);
        if (atIndex != -1) {
            s = s.substring(0, atIndex) + "@" + s.substring(atIndex + 2);
        }

        int searchStart = 1;
        while (true) {
            int dotIndex = s.indexOf("dot", searchStart);
            if (dotIndex == -1 || dotIndex > s.length() - 4) break;
            s = s.substring(0, dotIndex) + "." + s.substring(dotIndex + 3);
            searchStart = dotIndex + 1;
        }

        System.out.println(s);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
